dict.string: Lynote NoteTaker reads your calendar to name your notes after the meeting and to know who is in it. It stays on your Mac unless you turn on Cloud AI.
Lynote NoteTaker reads your calendar to name your notes after the meeting and to know who is in it. It stays on your Mac unless you turn on Cloud AI.
Lynote NoteTaker checks the browser tab's name to tell when you're in a call, and pauses your music while it records.
Lynote NoteTaker records your voice in meetings so it can write the transcript and your notes. The recording stays on your Mac.
Lynote NoteTaker records the sound of your calls so it can write down what others say. The recording stays on your Mac.
